subgoals.description: Search for and compile a list of potential venues in Edinburgh with basic details
subgoals.success_criterion: List of venues with names, locations, and key features

subgoals.description: Gather detailed information (address, capacity, pricing) for the top venue from the list
subgoals.success_criterion: Detailed data on the selected venue including all necessary event details

subgoals.description: Create a professional flyer using the selected venue's details and key features
subgoals.success_criterion: Completed flyer document ready for distribution
